Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner switched from the correct criterion (compare directors’ birthdates) to comparing their ages at the time of their films (37 vs. 31), misinterpreting “older” in temporal context. This led to an incorrect conclusion. Given the birthdates (Nunzio Malasomma: Feb 4, 1894; Don McGuire: Feb 28, 1919), Malasomma is older, so One Minute to Twelve has the older director.
